content: Real Madrid defeated Liverpool 1-0 in the 2022 UEFA Champions League final, which was held on May 28, 2022, at the Stade de France in Paris, France. Vinícius Júnior scored the only goal of the match in the second half, securing Real Madrid's 14th Champions League/European Cup title.
